description: Ireland: the Irish tax on selling assets held abroad (shares, EU/EEA/OECD funds and UCITS ETFs, non-OECD funds, a home abroad, a rental abroad, Irish land) in the year before moving to Ireland, in the arrival year before or after landing, or the year after: residence in the arrival year (183 days, 280 over two years, or election; ordinary residence for 3 years after leaving), no split-year relief for gains, CGT 31% with the EUR 1,270 exemption, funds like Irish funds at 38% in 2026 and 35% from 2027 (Budget 2027).
